title: Find a button by its name
why: Steps say a button's name, like "Cook Time". This is how to find it.

steps.text: Read the words on the buttons, one row at a time
The words may be in a different order, like "Time Cook". That is the same button

tips: "Timer" is a different button. It does not heat food
Still can't find it? Ask staff to show you once, then try it yourself
